//: Typechecks the atlas modules AND their tests.
The main tsconfig only includes src/**, so test files were never typechecked.
node --experimental-strip-types strips types without checking them, so a type
error in a test ran happily and produced wrong values. That is not theoretical: a
fixture helper in atlas-context.test.ts built tuple bounds where the code expected
{x,y,z}, so every adjacency distance was NaN and 'no muscle is adjacent' looked
Scoped to the atlas tests only. The pre-existing tests have a large backlog of
strict-mode errors that is real debt and deliberately not opened here.
